timing: Analysis addendum recorded after job launch but before accessing any final-run estimates, intervals, summaries or logs. The execution grid/source remain unchanged.
primary_comparison: grouped CR2 minus random CR2 coverage on complete shared-world blocks
benefit_rule: Require >=.02 improvement in absolute distance to .95, exact paired discordance-test Holm-adjusted p<.05 over the two focal conditions, and no >.01 worsening of absolute null-size distance to .05. This is a prespecified evidence criterion, not a theorem or equivalence claim.
paired_test: Exact two-sided binomial/McNemar test among discordant world-level coverage indicators; Holm over two focal conditions.
uncertainty: Per-cell Wilson95 and observed binomial MCSE; paired differences use SD(differences)/sqrt(R) and paired whole-world percentile bootstrap.
all_other_grid_comparisons: Descriptive/exploratory with full-grid reporting; no favourable subset replacement or omnibus superiority claim.
H4: Report K16-minus-K4 differences at the registered pair-density match, alongside exposure, covariance-strength and variance differences. Repeat with the secondary exposure match; do not call either full dependence-structure equivalence.
no_dependence_interpretation: Dense outcome dependence need not imply identical dependence in orthogonal scores; gamma=0 and gamma=1 are reported separately.
